049/**
050 * Standup the master and fake it to test various aspects of master function. Does NOT spin up a
051 * mini hbase nor mini dfs cluster testing master (it does put up a zk cluster but this is usually
052 * pretty fast compared). Also, should be possible to inject faults at points difficult to get at in
053 * cluster context. TODO: Speed up the zk connection by Master. It pauses 5 seconds establishing
054 * session.
055 */
056@Tag(MasterTests.TAG)
057@Tag(MediumTests.TAG)
058public class TestMasterNoCluster {
059
060  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TestMasterNoCluster.class);
061
062  private static final HBaseTestingUtil TESTUTIL = new HBaseTestingUtil();
063
064  @BeforeAll
065  public static void setUpBeforeClass() throws Exception {
066    Configuration c = TESTUTIL.getConfiguration();
067    // We use local filesystem. Set it so it writes into the testdir.
068    CommonFSUtils.setRootDir(c, TESTUTIL.getDataTestDir());
069    DefaultMetricsSystem.setMiniClusterMode(true);
070    // Startup a mini zk cluster.
071    TESTUTIL.startMiniZKCluster();
072  }
073
074  @AfterAll
075  public static void tearDownAfterClass() throws Exception {
076    TESTUTIL.shutdownMiniZKCluster();
077  }
078
079  @AfterEach
080  public void tearDown() throws KeeperException, ZooKeeperConnectionException, IOException {
081    // Make sure zk is clean before we run the next test.
082    ZKWatcher zkw = new ZKWatcher(TESTUTIL.getConfiguration(), "@BeforeEach", new Abortable() {
083      @Override
084      public void abort(String why, Throwable e) {
085        throw new RuntimeException(why, e);
086      }
087
088      @Override
089      public boolean isAborted() {
090        return false;
091      }
092    });
093    // Before fails sometimes so retry.
094    try {
095      TESTUTIL.waitFor(10000, (Waiter.Predicate<Exception>) () -> {
096        try {
097          ZKUtil.deleteNodeRecursively(zkw, zkw.getZNodePaths().baseZNode);
098          return true;
099        } catch (KeeperException.NotEmptyException e) {
100          LOG.info("Failed delete, retrying", e);
101        }
102        return false;
103      });
104    } catch (Exception e) {
105      LOG.info("Failed zk clear", e);
106    }
107    zkw.close();
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Test starting master then stopping it before its fully up.
112   */
113  @Test
114  public void testStopDuringStart() throws IOException, KeeperException, InterruptedException {
115    HMaster master = new HMaster(TESTUTIL.getConfiguration());
116    master.start();
117    // Immediately have it stop. We used hang in assigning meta.
118    master.stopMaster();
119    master.join();
120  }
121
122  /**
123   * The master reads and writes HFiles through its local MasterRegion, so it must enable IO metrics
124   * even when no RegionServer runs in the same JVM. See HBASE-30231.
125   */
126  @Test
127  public void testMasterEnablesMetricsIO() throws IOException, InterruptedException {
128    MetricsIO.resetForTesting();
129    HMaster master = new HMaster(TESTUTIL.getConfiguration());
130    master.start();
131    try {
132      assertTrue(MetricsIO.isEnabled());
133    } finally {
134      master.stopMaster();
135      master.join();
136      MetricsIO.resetForTesting();
137    }
138  }
139
140  @Test
141  public void testMasterInitWithSameClientServerZKQuorum() throws Exception {
142    Configuration conf = new Configuration(TESTUTIL.getConfiguration());
143    conf.set(HConstants.CLIENT_ZOOKEEPER_QUORUM, conf.get(ZOOKEEPER_QUORUM));
144    conf.setInt(HConstants.CLIENT_ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT, TESTUTIL.getZkCluster().getClientPort());
145    HMaster master = new HMaster(conf);
146    master.start();
147    // the master will abort due to IllegalArgumentException so we should finish within 60 seconds
148    master.join();
149  }
150
151  @Test
152  public void testMasterInitWithObserverModeClientZKQuorum() throws Exception {
153    Configuration conf = new Configuration(TESTUTIL.getConfiguration());
154    assertFalse(Boolean.getBoolean(HConstants.CLIENT_ZOOKEEPER_OBSERVER_MODE));
155    // set client ZK to some non-existing address and make sure server won't access client ZK
156    // (server start should not be affected)
157    conf.set(HConstants.CLIENT_ZOOKEEPER_QUORUM, HConstants.LOCALHOST);
158    conf.setInt(HConstants.CLIENT_ZOOKEEPER_CLIENT_PORT,
159      TESTUTIL.getZkCluster().getClientPort() + 1);
160    // need to enable maintenance mode so we will start master and an in process region server
161    conf.setBoolean(HMaster.MAINTENANCE_MODE, true);
162    // settings to allow us not to start additional RS
163    conf.setInt(ServerManager.WAIT_ON_REGIONSERVERS_MINTOSTART, 1);
164    // main setting for this test case
165    conf.setBoolean(HConstants.CLIENT_ZOOKEEPER_OBSERVER_MODE, true);
166    HMaster master = new HMaster(conf);
167    master.start();
168    while (!master.isInitialized()) {
169      Threads.sleep(200);
170    }
171    assertNull(master.getMetaLocationSyncer());
172    assertNull(master.masterAddressSyncer);
173    master.stopMaster();
174    master.join();
175  }
176}
